public_view_provenance.omitted_fields: All largest_radius_witnesses arrays, containing proprietary native triangle and UV witness data; no measured aggregate was changed.

scope_wording_clarification.clarification: Coplanar subdivision can extend beyond the exact route ribbons. UV remapping remains limited to those ribbons and the two explicit fixed-distance encoding certificates; original affine fields elsewhere remain preserved.
scope_wording_clarification.kind: Metadata-only scope clarification after independent review.

scope.UV_proof: Intersect actual saved old/new faces, subtract declared convex corridor polygons, and compare affine U and V at every exterior intersection-polygon vertex. Interior field/RGB acceptance is separately pinned and required. Only whole convex residuals with the pinned material/datum and one finite original-edge certificate can use the fixed binary32 encoding ceilings; no analytic region or UV tolerance is enlarged.
allowed_resource_differences: Existing native DD upward top-pavement S3D faces may be subdivided coplanarly, including outside the route ribbons, while covered planes, mutual surface coverage, boundaries, winding, and per-resource ownership remain checked against the baseline at the unchanged stated tolerances. Original affine UV fields outside the exact ribbons remain preserved, apart from the separately certified original-face encoding residuals.

UV remapping is confined to the exact independently reconstructed route ribbons, plus only the explicit whole-convex-polygon encoding certificates: at most 5 micrometres from ONE finite original corridor edge for the approved safe DD field, or at most 1 micrometre from ONE finite edge of the SAME affine-matching actual baseline UV face, or containment inside that face. Exact material, datum, branch, coordinate-envelope, independent field-evidence, and unchanged UV-tolerance guards remain mandatory.
scope.frozen_layers: Corrected WHITE geometry/material/UVs, authored asphalt, all other native surfaces, barriers, supports, textures, IDs, PATHs, definitions, layout, adaptive bindings, controller, and menu.
